name.description: Short name shown in the sidebar and in links, e.g. "my-app".

path.description: Absolute path to the docs folder; ~ means the home folder.

icon.description: An emoji or short symbol shown with it, e.g. "📐".

statusFolders.description: Folders that hold active and finished tasks, e.g. {"active":"active","done":"done"}; null if tasks sit directly in the docs folder.

plansFolder.description: Folder inside each task that holds its plans, e.g. "plans"; "" if plans sit in the task folder.

phasePattern.description: Regular expression for phase folder names; (?<num>...) captures the number, (?<slug>...) the name.

fileTypes.description: Extensions to show, without the dot, e.g. ["html","md"].

label.description: Section name in the sidebar, e.g. "Research".

folder.description: Folder name inside each task, e.g. "research".

fileTypes.description: Extensions to list here; defaults to fileTypes.

groups.description: Extra folders inside each task that get their own sidebar section.

label.description: Section name in the sidebar, e.g. "Weekly".

path.description: Path pattern inside the docs folder; * matches one name, e.g. "weekly/*/*.html".

newestFirst.description: Newest first; otherwise sorted by path.

notify.description: Show a notification when a new one appears.

collections.description: Docs outside any task, listed by a path pattern.

folders.description: The docs folders to read. Each may override any layout key below for itself.

folder.description: Folder name inside each task, e.g. "research".

newestFirst.description: Newest first; otherwise sorted by path.

notify.description: Show a notification when a new one appears.

collections.description: Docs outside any task, listed by a path pattern.

additionalProperties.description: An emoji or short symbol shown with it, e.g. "📐".

taskIcons.description: Icons for tasks, by "<folder name>:<task folder>", e.g. {"work:search-rewrite": "🔎"}.

moveTabLeft.description: Move the shown tab to the pane on the left, splitting one off if there is none

moveTabRight.description: Move the shown tab to the pane on the right, splitting one off if there is none

moveTabUp.description: Move the shown tab to the pane above, splitting one off if there is none

moveTabDown.description: Move the shown tab to the pane below, splitting one off if there is none

nextTab.description: Show the next tab in the focused pane

previousTab.description: Show the previous tab in the focused pane

splitRight.description: Split the shown tab into a new pane on the right

splitDown.description: Split the shown tab into a new pane below

openPhase.description: Open phase 1-9 of the current task: modifiers only, e.g. "Ctrl" for Ctrl+1

hotkeys.description: Keyboard shortcuts by action, each a list of combos like "Alt+W". Leave an action out to keep its default; [] turns it off.

match.description: File name pattern; * matches anything, e.g. "eli5*.html".

icon.description: An emoji or short symbol shown with it, e.g. "📐".

docTypes.description: Badges by file name. A file takes the first match; the order is also the reading order.
